scope: Controlled single-picture step 9b fixture on a legacy local Boxing site; not full WO or business-site acceptance

cleanReplay.auditSettlement: The HTTP-only harness deliberately starts no cron or paid queues. One supported moment/wait request settled the native moment job after its normal 202 response. Repair wall time includes this harness delay; native time is separate.

excludedAttempts.reason: Missing DNS alias prevented broker and audit calls; two immediate SUBSCRIPTION_UNAVAILABLE turns, no product verdict

A later attempt applied the picture after one synthetic Joomla-fragment SLOT_IMAGE_INVALID, but PostgreSQL disk failure interrupted orchestration and audit close. Its native 51977 ms completion is not a production repair PASS. The exact recorded native completion was later finalized through the supported moment door.

visualReview.result: The official BXR photo replaces the demo background; the existing banner text and geometry remain. Other template demo content is outside this fixture.

resources.observation: One observation during the clean replay, not a measured peak

limitations: The real agent and existing provider ran, with the current production repair orchestrator and exact new hint.
